body:
We used an offline VM running a copy of our Agie Classic Cut 2S machine control. We checked both left and right straight cutoffs. The control plotted one stock crossing per pass, with four alternating passes and both endpoints in air. The traces showed no additional cutting move through the stock.

All controller runs were offline. No physical cut was made.

Port onto the current frame, head `f99a9d736`.

- The branch merges the #2969 port (`d3443eddc`). That head includes main `44e6a8269`, with the zero-step writer of #2984 and the inspection setup of #3219. There was no rebase and no force-push.
- The old `jescript.rs` writer is gone. The open cut now uses the zero-step writer: `agie_setup::CutoffSetup20` writes `c_left` or `c_right`, `stp1` and `stp2` in air, `ID_SEPCUT "0.0"` and ASDELETE only. ASAGIE is gone.
- A closed cycle keeps the 1.0 mm separation rule. A closed cycle with 0.0 is still refused (`an_open_cut_posts_zero_steps_and_no_separation_and_a_closed_cut_keeps_one_millimetre`).
- The CCSEP20 and DIE20 goldens do not change. The new golden is `LOWER20.SBL`.
- Offline control import on 2026-11-24, for `LOWER20` and `UPPER20`: `CCB030[0]` after import, the left or right side, an open contour with entry `stp1` and exit `stp2`, and no separation. After TECCUT: `CCB030[4]`, offsets 245, 155, 140 and 134 µm, and `geen fouten`. The plots show four passes with one crossing each, at the same Y values as the earlier control run of this PR. The PR body has the details.
- Quick gate: 1190 steps, 1 red step that is not in this diff (`rotary_verify`, red on main since #3774). Clippy is clean.

Needs changes before merge: two required items.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I read the complete net diff against upstream main `f519445d4fa816fbdf2689416910a1cd92938819`.
The local trial merge is `d0d0ebbb91a021d01e47bed53ab6ee02a3e662e7`. Its first parent is the PR head above.

What looks good:

- The open cut uses separate air entry and exit points. The closed cut keeps its 1 mm separation rule.
- The two setup declarations default to false. The project round trip and UI Apply/Undo tests pass.
- I checked all 83 lines of the new `LOWER20.SBL` golden. The existing `CCSEP20` and `DIE20` goldens do not change.
- `Process change: yes` is present. This PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local build and test results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 525 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. This includes the selected build steps and UI tests from `crates/ui`.
- Test totals: post 1,243 passed; app 2,730 passed; UI 1,629 passed. There were 47 ignored tests.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 11 tests passed across 6 gate steps; 0 failed; 0 stalled.
- Bare main at the base above: `flute_reach` (3 passed, 1 ignored), `pocket3d_hsm` (2 passed, 2 ignored), and `rotary_verify` (10 passed). These also passed on the trial merge. The earlier failures did not recur.

Extra suites run:

- `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed each.
- Golden readers: post `agie_cutoff_setup` (4 passed), post `agie_safe_setup` (8 passed), and app `agie_native` (18 passed).
- Post `agie_inspection`: 2 passed. The cutoff geometry, DTO and UI pinning tests also passed in the lib suites.
- The net diff against this base changes no importer or STEP fixture.

Mutations checked independently through the CLI:

- Both unmodified examples passed. Each ISO had one cutting crossing. The lower SBL matched the golden byte for byte.
- I repeated all six input mutations from `unsafe_or_unconfirmed_cutoffs_publish_no_files`: remove restraint, remove centering, reverse the kerf side, add a start hole, increase clearance, and move the stock faces.
- All six mutated inputs were refused. None published a job directory. Both original inputs gave green results.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:235`: the PR adds two visible controls, but its body has no before/after UI screenshots. Add both views on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them in the PR body. The control-import notes do not show the changed Camcraft page.
2. `crates/post/tests/agie_cutoff_setup.rs:1`: this is a new top-level integration test binary. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, **New tests join a directory suite**, requires a one-line reason in the PR body. Explain why this needs a separate binary, or move the tests into the existing setup suite.

No physical control run or physical cut was made during this review. Full heavy lanes were not run for this P6 enhancement, per #3556.
The review worktree and branch remain in place. No PR source was edited.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

@qsmits, before/after screenshots for the two open-cutoff controls the review asks for (the same UI change is in #2972 and #2978, so one pair covers both). Rendered headlessly through the crate's own egui_kittest harness: the Wire Contour **Passes** tab with side = Left, once on main and once on #2978's head `124be7caf` (a scratch test, never committed).

**Before** (main): no clamp or travel declarations.
![before: Wire Contour Passes tab on main](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-2972/wire-open-cutoff-before.png?raw=true)

**After**: "Both pieces clamped through all passes" and "Stock centered in installed XY travel" appear for a Left/Right open cut.
![after: Wire Contour Passes tab with the two declarations](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-2972/wire-open-cutoff-after.png?raw=true)

The images are on mkinney/Camcraft's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch; link them in the PR body as they are. The other review items (PR-body lines) are still yours.
This PR goes back to draft for the review fixes. The fix moves the new top-level test binary into an existing suite. The PR is flagged ready again when the gate is green.

Reply to the review of `f99a9d736` (comment 7125515418). New head: `c61014a41`.

1. **Screenshots** (`wire_page.rs:235`): the body has the before/after pair from the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, in "UI screenshots".
2. **New top-level test binary** (`agie_cutoff_setup.rs:1`): the four tests moved unchanged into the existing suite `agie_safe_setup`, as the module `cutoff` (`crates/post/tests/agie_safe_setup/cutoff.rs`). Only the golden path changed (`../golden/`). The suite has 12 tests (8 + 4). The PR adds no new top-level test file now. The body has a "Test layout" section.

Pinning tests: `agie_safe_setup` `cutoff::cutoff_setup_matches_the_control_checked_zero_step_open_cut` and the three other `cutoff::` tests (12 passed).

Gate on `c61014a41`: the head merges `origin/main` `aedd9750c`, which has the fix of #3774. `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 525 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Strict clippy (`-D warnings`, all targets): clean. The merge with main is clean.

Delta class (`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 2972 --reviewed f99a9d736`): NEW CODE. The new commits are `b4254e568` (the test move) and `c61014a41` (a merge of main with no hand edits).

Ready for a re-check.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding remains.

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review. I read the complete net diff against main `1fe369fabbb3b15f49cfb7f387261acfbd423ed3`.
The local trial merge is `fd86a5b0e2add78bda5dffb4490d1e8cea36a5ae`. Its first parent is the PR head above.
All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

**Earlier findings**

The [earlier review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2972#issuecomment-7125515418) requested two items. I checked the [author's reply](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2972#issuecomment-7130822004).

1. Screenshots: fixed. The body links both views from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. I opened both images. The after view shows both new controls.
2. Test layout: fixed by `b4254e5680a1d6da5709ffac9cc8de0eb7cebff8`. All four tests now belong to `agie_safe_setup`. Only their module declaration and golden path changed. The suite passes all 12 tests.

**Local results**

- Quick gate: 525 steps; 524 passed, 1 failed, 0 stalled; 43.6 minutes.
- Post: 1,243 tests passed. App: 2,749 passed, 41 ignored. UI: 1,667 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored.
- Strict clippy passed: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Light lane: 11 tests across 6 steps passed; 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- The cutoff Apply/Undo test, DTO round trip and MCP field test passed.

The one red gate step is `ui suites: lib`. Six `egui_app::report_tests` failed:

- `a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window`
- `no_answer_copies_nothing`
- `the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word`
- `the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url`
- `the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed`
- `the_title_field_travels_into_the_url`

`egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` also failed. The errors are:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

I ran the same full UI lib step on bare upstream main `6d0381f1977b267885e22b3ddf55950b098fd319`, in this worktree.
Main failed the same seven tests with the same adapter errors: 1,580 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored.
These host failures do not block this PR under the requested bare-main comparison rule. I found no issue that tracks these specific UI failures.
The earlier `flute_reach`, `pocket3d_hsm` and `rotary_verify` failures did not recur on the trial merge.

**Extra suites run**

I ran these suites explicitly by name after the quick gate:

- Post `agie_safe_setup`: 12 passed. Post `agie_inspection`: 2 passed.
- App `agie_native`: 18 passed.
- App `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored.
- App `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed each.

The golden readers are covered by `agie_safe_setup` and `agie_native`.
The diff changes no importer or STEP fixture. No extra kernel importer suite is required.

**Independent safety checks**

- Both original CLI examples passed. Each ISO has one cutting crossing. The lower SBL matches its golden byte for byte.
- I repeated all six input mutations: remove restraint, remove centering, reverse the kerf side, add a start hole, increase clearance, and move the stock faces.
- All six inputs were refused. None published a job directory. The reversed kerf side was blocked by the gouge check.
- I checked all 83 lines of `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/LOWER20.SBL`. It is the only added or changed golden and is listed under "Goldens moved".
- The existing CCSEP20 and DIE20 goldens do not change. Closed contours keep their 1 mm separation requirement.
- `Process change: yes` is present. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION` or add dependencies.

Requested before merge: none. The clean review replaces the earlier `needs-rework` verdict on the older head.
No physical cut was made. Full heavy lanes were not run for this P6 enhancement, per current upstream law.
The review worktree and branch remain in place. No PR source or evidence was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
